description: Live code source graph MCP server for .NET solutions. Indexes C#/Roslyn into SQLite + FTS5 and exposes graph queries (find_definition, find_references, list_callers, neighborhood, impact_of_change, find_diagnostics, list_generated_files, list_tests_for, who_authored, recent_changes, ...) over stdio MCP. Watches the filesystem for incremental updates. v0.4 adds optional code-aware semantic_search backed by ONNX embeddings + sqlite-vec (gated behind --no-embeddings), Roslyn diagnostics indexing, source-generator document tracking, test-method discrimination + Tests edges, and per-symbol git blame history.
